hero.title: AgentX
hero.subtitle: Trading Evolves. Never Stops.
hero.desc: Not a tool. Not a plugin. AgentX is your AI trading agent — perceives markets, makes decisions, evolves continuously. Connect your exchange API. It handles the rest.

howItWorks.title: The Evolution Path of an Agent
howItWorks.subtitle: From signal to decision to self-iteration. Three stages define a new paradigm in AI trading.

stages.title: Perceive
stages.desc: Real-time access to on-chain data, order books, social sentiment, macro indicators. Not passively waiting for alerts — the Agent actively scans, cross-validates, and filters noise. You see conclusions. It sees the full picture.

stages.title: Decide & Act
stages.desc: Generates strategies from multi-factor models. Automatically calculates position size, take-profit, stop-loss, execution timing. Every trade comes with a complete reasoning chain — not a black box, but a traceable decision process.

stages.title: Evolve
stages.desc: Every trade cycle is training data. The Agent reviews its own decisions, quantifies each factor's actual contribution, and retires failed strategies. No manual tuning needed — it adapts on its own.

cards.title: Multi-Source Perception Engine
cards.desc: On-chain anomalies, CEX order flow, Twitter/Telegram sentiment, macro calendar — four signal streams fused in real time. Not data hoarding. Finding causation in noise.

cards.title: Autonomous Trading Framework
cards.desc: Signal to order, fully automated. Supports spot, futures, grid, DCA — multiple strategies running in parallel. Every action logged with full reasoning. Audit anytime.

cards.title: Strategy Self-Evolution
cards.desc: A closed trade isn't the end. The Agent auto-backtests, attributes, and retires weak factors. Next cycle runs on the updated model. Not version upgrades — continuous evolution.

whyAgentX.title: Not a Tool. An Ecosystem.
whyAgentX.desc: Tools solve point problems. AgentX builds a trading intelligence network — Agents share strategies, compete in rankings, co-evolve. Each Agent grows stronger with use. The network grows with every Agent.
points: Each Agent runs independently. Strategies never leak.
Competitive ranking drives survival of the fittest.
Strategy marketplace lets top strategies monetize.
Developers build custom Skills to extend capabilities.

cards.title: AES-256 Encrypted
cards.desc: API keys are encrypted server-side. Never stored or transmitted in plaintext.

cards.title: No Withdrawal Access
cards.desc: Only trade and read permissions. Withdrawal API is never touched.

cards.title: Full Audit Trail
cards.desc: Every trade, every decision — complete logs available for review anytime.

items.q: Is AgentX safe? Are my funds at risk?
items.a: AgentX never custodies your funds. API keys only have trade and read permissions — no withdrawal access. Keys are AES-256 encrypted, decrypted in memory at runtime, and wiped after use.

items.q: Do I need a technical background?
items.a: Not for basic agents. Pick a preset strategy, configure parameters, and start. Developers can use the SDK to build custom strategies.
CoinW is supported now. More exchanges are being integrated.

items.q: Is there a fee during beta?
items.a: All basic features are free during the public beta.

items.q: Will my strategy be visible to other users?
items.a: No. Each agent runs independently with fully isolated strategy parameters. Listing on the strategy marketplace is opt-in — if you don't list, only you can see it.
